rows.definition: The internal/relay function that refuses a relay rotation with RELAY_NOT_EXTERNALIZED when any load-bearing fact is still transcript-only, else admits the rotate.
rows.distinction: It is the pure ADMISSION FUNCTION for the externalize precondition, not the ExternalizeGate result type it returns and not GuardRotation, a separate pre-rotation assertion.

rows.definition: The internal/relay struct CheckExternalizeGate returns: Admit bool plus, when refused, the RELAY_NOT_EXTERNALIZED reason and the transcript-only Culprits the leg must externalize or park on.
rows.distinction: It is the DATA/VERDICT type the check produces, not CheckExternalizeGate, the function that computes it, and not GuardRotation, a different pre-rotation assertion.

rows.definition: The env var that opts an attended `fak guard` launch out of the in-place icon launch animation (guard_launch_anim.go), falling back to the static compact banner when set to off.
rows.distinction: It is the ENV TOGGLE for the launch animation, not guardBannerAnimate, the --banner mode value that selects animate mode, and not printGuardCompactBanner, the static banner it falls back to.

rows.definition: The GGUF/safetensors tensor name for a MoE layer's ROUTER gate (expert-selection logits), handled in fak's GGUF loading and MoE weight-quantizer path.
rows.distinction: It is the ROUTER gate tensor that picks which experts fire, not ffn_gate, the existing per-expert FFN gate-projection tensor, and not gateUp/gateName, the fused gate+up load-time locals.

rows.definition: The internal/hooks helper that reads a positive-integer operator tuning knob from the environment for the SIZE hygiene gates (GOD_FILE_GROWTH, FILE_ADMISSION), falling back to a default on unset/unparseable/non-positive input.
rows.distinction: It is a GENERIC env-parsing utility shared by gate ceilings, not FAK_GITGATE, a specific gate on/off toggle, and not any one hygiene gate itself.

rows.definition: The `fak guard allow` operator control-surface subcommand (cmd/fak/guard_allow.go, entry cmdGuardAllow) for inspecting and editing the guard's runtime allow overlay.
rows.distinction: It is the CLI SUBCOMMAND an operator runs, not guardApplyAllowOverlay, the existing mechanism that applies the overlay file this subcommand edits.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_child.go helper that appends a resume flag to a relaunch command unless already present, so a repeated auth-crash-recover or budget-restart cycle never stacks the flag twice.
rows.distinction: It is the IDEMPOTENT APPEND primitive, not guardContinueFlagForAgent, which decides which flag is safe to use, and not guardRestartRelaunchCommand, which calls both to build the full relaunch command.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_local.go function that sets FAK_PROVIDER_EXTRA_BODY_JSON from the detected local backend's label/model (e.g. a Qwen3.6 quirk body) unless the operator already set one.
rows.distinction: It is the ENV-SETTING side effect for a detected local backend, not guardDetectLocalBackend, the probe that finds the backend, and not guardLocalDetectedBanner, the render of the detection result.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_support.go helper returning the .dispatch-runs/guard-audit directory under a repo root where fak guard's interactive decision-journal files live.
rows.distinction: It is the plain DIRECTORY helper guardDefaultAuditPath composes a filename into, not guardAuditPath, the unrelated dispatch-worker per-session journal-path builder, and not guardPolicyDigest, a policy hash rather than a path.

rows.definition: The cmd/dispatchworker/guard.go function building a per-session guard decision-journal path under .dispatch-runs/guard-audit/, keyed by lane+backend plus a pid+random-token discriminator so concurrent dispatch workers never braid one hash-chained journal.
rows.distinction: It is the DISPATCH-WORKER fleet path (pid + random token), not guardDefaultAuditPath, the interactive `fak guard -- claude` default keyed by pid + repo hash, and not guardAuditDir, the plain directory helper the interactive path composes into.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_banner.go constant naming the --banner=animate mode: the attended-interactive default that plays the in-place icon launch animation instead of the static compact banner.
rows.distinction: It is one of the four --banner MODE VALUES (auto/full/compact/animate), not guardBannerFull, the always-full mode, and not printGuardCompactBanner, the static banner it degrades to.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_banner.go constant naming the --banner=full mode: always print fak guard's complete startup report, forced (today's pre-flag behavior).
rows.distinction: It is the FULL-report --banner mode value, not guardBannerAnimate, the animated attended default, and not the compact/off mode constants that are its other siblings.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_child.go injectable var (defaults to procguard.KillPID) used as the destructive escalation that kills a wrapped child's whole process tree when it does not exit within the graceful-interrupt window.
rows.distinction: It is the ESCALATION KILL primitive for a hung child, not FleetProcResourceGuard, the OS-level scheduled task killing runaway fleet processes, and not guardRestartRelaunchCommand, the relaunch that may follow a kill.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_format_layout.go function that layers TTY color onto an already-assembled guard exit summary at print time, dimming structural chrome without re-parsing the value-bearing rows.
rows.distinction: It is a PRINT-TIME color layer over an already-formatted string, not the guard report layout (guardRow/guardSection) that structurally formats it, and not printGuardCompactBanner, a different render surface.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_child.go function returning the resume/continue flag fak knows is safe to auto-inject for a recognized wrapped agent (currently only Claude Code's --continue); ok=false for anything unrecognized.
rows.distinction: It is the DECISION of which flag is safe, not guardAppendContinueFlag, which mechanically appends it, and not guardRestartRelaunchCommand, which uses both to build a full relaunch command.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard.go embedded byte slice holding the day-to-day capability-floor policy fak guard enforces when the operator names no --policy, so guard works from any directory with no source tree present.
rows.distinction: It is the EMBEDDED DEFAULT POLICY DOCUMENT itself, not guardPolicyDigest, the sha256 digest computed over policy bytes, and not the guard kernel that enforces it.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_local.go function that probes the conventional local model endpoints in precedence order and returns the chosen OpenAI-compatible base/model/label, or found=false if none answered.
rows.distinction: It is the I/O PROBE half of --local detection, not guardChooseLocalBackend, its pure decision half, and not guardLocalDetectedBanner, the render of a positive result.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_local.go pure function rendering the positive --local detection banner (label, base URL, model) printed once guardDetectLocalBackend finds a live endpoint.
rows.distinction: It is the POSITIVE-CASE render, not guardLocalNothingDetectedMessage, the fail-loud negative-case one-liner, and not guardDetectLocalBackend, the probe that decides which case applies.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_local.go pure function returning the fail-loud one-liner printed when --local probed every conventional endpoint and found none running.
rows.distinction: It is the NEGATIVE-CASE message, not guardLocalDetectedBanner, the positive-case banner, and not guardDetectLocalBackend, the probe producing the found bool that selects between them.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_mcp.go struct recording what installGuardMCPRegistration did (Applied/ConfigPath/URL/Reason) when wiring fak's MCP surface into a Claude Code child, used by the startup banner and tests.
rows.distinction: It is the RESULT RECORD of the MCP registration install, not guardPreCompactInstall, the analogous record for the PreCompact hook install, and not guardStopHookInstall, the analogous record for the Stop hook install.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_support.go function computing a sha256:<hex> digest over the resolved policy bytes fak guard is enforcing, surfaced in the startup report so an operator can tell which floor is active.
rows.distinction: It is a HASH over the policy bytes, not guardDefaultPolicyJSON, the embedded policy bytes themselves, and not guardAuditDir, an unrelated path helper.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_precompact.go struct recording what the PreCompact hook installer did (Applied/Mode/SettingsPath/MetricsURL/Reason) when wiring the Claude-Code PreCompact hook into a child's settings.
rows.distinction: It is the RESULT RECORD for the PreCompact hook install, not guardStopHookInstall, the analogous Stop-hook record, and not guardMCPInstall, the analogous MCP-registration record.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_child.go function returning the command to relaunch a wrapped child with after a budget restart, appending the agent's resume flag for a recognized agent so the relaunch reattaches the existing transcript.
rows.distinction: It is the FULL RELAUNCH COMMAND builder used on a budget restart, not guardContinueFlagForAgent, its flag-lookup dependency, and not guardAppendContinueFlag, its idempotent-append dependency, both of which it composes.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_rotate.go function that, before a raw `fak guard -- claude` launch, checks the fleet-shared cooldown store and returns a live alternate account's config dir if the currently-resolved account sits inside an active cooldown window.
rows.distinction: It is the specific PRE-LAUNCH, fail-open cooldown-rotation mechanism (one half of the broader guard account rotation / failover concept), not GuardRotation, the unrelated internal/relay in-flight-turn rotation assertion.

rows.definition: The internal/relay function (rung E2) that refuses a relay rotation with IN_FLIGHT_TOOL_CALL while a tool call/decode is mid-turn, and otherwise asserts the NoInFlightTurn axis onto the E1 SafePoint conjunction.
rows.distinction: It is the RELAY SAFE-POINT axis assertion for perpetual-session rotation, unrelated to guardRotateOffCooldown, the cmd/fak seat-cooldown account rotation, and not CheckExternalizeGate, a different pre-rotation precondition.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_session_pressure.go family (runGuardSessionPressureGate over guardSessionPressureGateConfig) that reads sessionaudit compaction-pressure history and can refuse a `fak guard` launch when a namespace's recent compact-action pressure crosses an operator threshold.
rows.distinction: It is a PRE-LAUNCH pressure/compaction-history gate, not the PreCompact hook, which fires mid-session on the wrapped agent's own compaction, and not the Stop-hook deny-all-continue install this row's sibling covers.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_stophook.go struct recording what installGuardStopHook did (Applied/Mode/WarnAt/FinalAt/Max/SameStop/StopsLedger/Reason) when wiring the deny-all-continue Stop hook into a child's settings.
rows.distinction: It is the RESULT RECORD for the Stop-hook install, not guardStopHook, the deny-all continue hook mechanism itself, and not guardPreCompactInstall/guardMCPInstall, its sibling install records for other hooks.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_stophook.go struct (Mode/File/Repo/Live) carrying the task-handoff posture wired into the Stop hook, consumed by runGuardTaskHandoffGate to decide whether a stop needs a written handoff first.
rows.distinction: It is the TASK-HANDOFF configuration passed into the Stop hook, not guardStopHookInstall, the broader install record it is embedded in, and not guardSessionPressureGateConfig, an unrelated launch-time config struct.

rows.definition: The internal/guardvars package holding the canonical wire shapes (e.g. SessionVars) shared field-for-field by the /debug/vars gateway producer and the `fak info` cmd/fak consumer, so a new field cannot silently drop between the two.
rows.distinction: It is the SHARED TYPE-DEFINITION leaf preventing producer/consumer field drift, not guardInfoVars, the cmd/fak info-pane consumer alias of these types, and not the gateway debug producer itself.

rows.definition: The internal/hooks/tree.go struct type (Name, Check, DefaultOff) describing one whole-tree `fak hygiene` audit gate; HygieneGates() returns the ordered slice of them that `make hygiene`/CI run.
rows.distinction: It is the per-gate STRUCT TYPE (one row's shape), not 'hygiene gates', the existing doc-term for the whole audited family, and not a staged pre-commit Gate, which carries a ModeEnv/EscapeEnv this struct deliberately omits.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_banner.go function rendering the attended-launch compact banner: three lines instead of the full startup report, printed per the --banner mode decision.
rows.distinction: It is the STATIC three-line banner renderer, not guardBannerAnimate, the animated attended default it is a fallback for, and not guardColorizeSummary, which colors the exit summary, a different render surface.

rows.definition: The internal/frontierswe/run.go struct (Runnable/DockerPresent/IntegrityOK/Reason/RemoteCommand) reporting whether the real C7 SWE-bench environment could be stood up on this host, and the exact remote command to run it where it cannot.
rows.distinction: It is a SWE-bench harness HOST-CAPABILITY report, unrelated to a tool-call adjudication gate; distinct from PreflightGate, the rehearsal host-capability gate for a different harness, and from the generic decision-point gate concept.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/accounts_launch.go launchOpts field deciding whether `fak accounts launch` wraps the started agent in `fak guard` (kernel adjudication + vCache) or execs it bare.
rows.distinction: It is the LAUNCH-TIME boolean choosing whether to wrap in the guard kernel, not cmdGuard, the guard entry point itself, and not guardedLaunchCommand, the dispatch/session-side equivalent wiring.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak/guard_precompact.go helper that writes a Claude Code settings.json atomically (sibling temp file plus rename), shared by the PreCompact, Stop-hook, and MCP hook installers.
rows.distinction: It is the shared LOW-LEVEL ATOMIC FILE WRITE primitive, not any one hook's install record (guardPreCompactInstall/guardStopHookInstall/guardMCPInstall) that calls it.
